title: A trip to the dentist
instructions: Ece diş hekimine gittiği günü anlatıyor. Sorunu ve sonucu takip et.

script.speaker: ece
script.text: Last Tuesday, I had a terrible toothache, so I went to the dentist.

script.speaker: ece
script.text: I was very nervous, because I hate dentists.

script.speaker: ece
script.text: The dentist was very kind. She looked at my teeth and found a small hole.

script.speaker: ece
script.text: She fixed it in twenty minutes, and it didn't hurt at all.

script.speaker: ece
script.text: She told me to eat fewer sweets and to brush my teeth twice a day.

questions.prompt: Why did Ece go to the dentist?
How long did the dentist take?
questions.evidence: She fixed it in twenty minutes

questions.prompt: What did the dentist tell Ece?
questions.feedback: Daha az şeker yemesini ve günde iki kez diş fırçalamasını söyledi.
questions.evidence: She told me to eat fewer sweets
